facts.business: Tata Investment Corporation Limited is a non-banking financial company (NBFC) primarily engaged in investment activities, holding a portfolio of quoted and unquoted equity shares, mutual funds, and government securities.
key_risks: Global economic slowdown due to higher energy prices
Geopolitical risks such as US-Iran war impacting markets
Volatility in global equity markets with frequent sentiment shifts
Commodity price inflation touching lifetime highs
Liquidity risk despite high LCR, dependence on HQLA
Concentration risk in investment portfolio (e.g., Tata group companies)
Regulatory and compliance risks under SEBI Listing Regulations
facts.related_party_note: The company has a policy for related party transactions; transactions are pre-approved by the Audit Committee. Schedule of related party transactions and year-end balances obtained and reviewed. Minutes of Audit Committee meetings where such transactions were pre-approved were read.
